name: get_availability
description: Find advisor call slots for this lead. Dates are in the lead's local timezone. Returns up to 6 slots, each with an opaque slot_id and a local_label. Only offer times from this result.

name: book_call
description: Book the advisor call in a slot the lead explicitly chose. slot_id must come from the latest get_availability result. Returns BOOKED, SLOT_TAKEN or an error.
